dedupe_keys.name: insurance loss data sharing for climate resilient municipalities norway pilot

description: This Climate-ADAPT case study describes a Norwegian pilot, run from September 2013 to February 2015 at the initiative of Finance Norway, in which insurers shared asset-level claims data on weather damage with nine municipalities, among them Bærum, Stavanger, Tromsø and Trondheim, to guide flood risk management and the renewal of public infrastructure such as drainage. Norwegian insurers paid about 2 billion kroner a year for flood damage to buildings in 2008-2017, and pluvial flood payouts are about 3.5 times riverine ones. Finance Norway gathered data from insurers, and Western Norway Research Institute and NTNU helped municipalities import and analyse it; Trondheim received 17,000 claims over ten years, of which about 54 percent could be geocoded, and the data revealed vulnerable areas the city had not identified. Funding was 1 million kroner from Finance Norway and 260,000 kroner from the Ministry of Climate and Environment. In 2018 a partnership between the Directorate for Civil Protection (DSB) and Finance Norway continued data exchange for DSB's Knowledge Bank. The page, published in 2020 and updated in 2026, is accessible online as free HTML on the Climate-ADAPT portal. Caveats: claims need better location, event dates and causes, and many municipalities lack skills to process the data. It illustrates the use of loss data for cross-sector flood risk and vulnerability assessment and climate adaptation; related records are the EM-DAT and NCEI hazards data.
name: Insurance loss data sharing for climate-resilient municipalities (Norway pilot)
organisations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
outcomes: All nine municipalities found the claims data useful, Trondheim found new flood-prone areas, and a national data exchange with DSB followed in 2018.
provider: Climate-ADAPT (European Environment Agency), case study based on Finance Norway, NTNU, Western Norway Research Institute and SINTEF reports
resources_used: asset-level insurance claims data from Finance Norway members
